base_member_text: This is generated cpp output (build/pre/) of bc.F with PARALLEL active and CARTESIAN apparently off (PERIODIC handled at runtime, no DX scalar branches remain) -- flag set of the originating build is not recorded in the file (stray comments '! end cartesian' L512, '! end parallel' L508 are residue of stripped preprocessor blocks).

MASK (integer array in GLOBAL) is ghost-exchanged through a REAL copy rMASK (L324-326) because PHI_COLL only accepts REAL(SP) -- implicit real-to-int truncation on assignment back; relation L298 vs L324-326.

PHI_COLL declares nreq,ll,l,JJ,myvar,mybeta (L439, L442) that are never used; the periodic exchange serializes MPI_SEND before posting the matching MPI_IRECV on the peer (L453-494) -- correct only while messages fit MPI's eager buffering.

PHI_COLL's PY=1 in-place periodic wrap copies over I=Ibeg..Iend only (L499-504) while the PY>1 path exchanges full Mloc rows including x-ghosts (L454, L468) -- corner ghost handling differs between the two paths.

Compared with the GPU port (FUNWAVE-GPU/src/exchange_gpu0819.F): here EXCHANGE_DISPERSION exchanges ETATx/ETATy (L229-231) which the GPU version comments out; EXCHANGE additionally exchanges radiation-stress fields Wsurf/P_center/Q_center/U_davg/V_davg (L304-308) absent there; loop indices I,J,K are GLOBAL module variables (no local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE in each routine).
phi_exch (L781) is defined elsewhere (MPI halo exchange); VTYPE=4 y-direction zeroing carries the comment 'this one is not an exact solution' (chunk3, before the VTYPE=4 south block).

audit_member_text: Halo-exchange interface gap across L324-L325,L365-L414,L781: EXCHANGE sends staggered P/Q through PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH, but that routine only reflects physical-edge ghosts and returns without any MPI/phi_exch call; ordinary PHI_COLL always finishes with phi_exch. Unless another caller-owned exchange exists, P/Q internal-processor halos remain stale when these fields are enabled.

Periodic overwrite defect across L445-L504 and L664-L779: PHI_COLL fills periodic y ghosts first, and VTYPE 1/2/3 protect later y boundary logic with .NOT.PERIODIC (e.g. L643), but VTYPE 4/5/6 south/north blocks have no such guard. On periodic end ranks they can overwrite periodic data with zero, symmetric, or antisymmetric physical-boundary values before phi_exch.

Boundary-condition halo-range dependency in L120-L194: loops already span Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1, then access MASK(I-1,J), MASK(I+1,J), MASK(I,J-1), MASK(I,J+1) and P/F/G at I+1 or J+1. Correctness requires at least two addressable halo layers at extremes; this file neither asserts Nghost>=2 nor bounds-checks those accesses.
PHI_COLL accepts any integer VTYPE (L434) but has no else/error branch outside 1..6; an invalid code silently skips physical-boundary semantics and still calls phi_exch at L781.
